description: This file contains test cases for the configuration update and chat completion functionalities, focusing on integration with Langfuse logging system. It uses pytest and asyncio for asynchronous testing, and checks that logs are correctly sent to Langfuse during chat completions.

methods.name: config_update(session)
methods.description: Sends a POST request to update configuration settings, including environment variables and callback settings.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key, model="azure-gpt-3.5", request_metadata=None)
methods.description: Sends a chat prompt to the server and prints the response; used to generate logs for testing.
